state.background: Implemented the approved residual E2E audit plan. B14 adds four production-route Browser Mode tests: dark legend hover reset and contrast in an isolated dark colorScheme context; Space activation toggles aria-pressed; keyboard Tab reaches the named legend and exposes a focus-visible outline; reducedMotion context suppresses header animation and legend transition durations. Removed the active normal advanced-series Playwright spec after source-boundary comparison with existing batch3-b production-route coverage, removed the mobile LazyMount smoke with no expect, and retired six unconditional skipped accessibility tests after moving the meaningful dark, keyboard, focus-visible, and reduced-motion predicates. The truthy-color and locator-object-only checks were not retained. Kept tooltip #231 and left all prior unknown-provenance deletions unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: B14 exercises the production route with real browser contexts and four meaningful residual accessibility assertions.
The original 33 Phase5/Phase6 roster count stays A=123/E=123/M=123; B14 is a separately tracked residual-audit addition.
Only exact duplicate, no-assertion, or inactive weak checks are retired; unique active #231 touch-open assertions and unknown-provenance source changes are preserved.
The built aggregate Browser Mode and fresh residual E2E runs pass, and lint plus whitespace checks pass.
verification: Focused B14 Browser Mode: 1 file, 4 passed; results/plan45/phase6/phase6-b14-focused-browser-mode-validation-2026-09-27.log.

Built aggregate Browser Mode: B01-B14 configs passed; legacy Chromium 9 files / 80 passed; WebKit 5 files / 21 passed / 5 skipped; results/plan45/phase6/phase6-b14-full-browser-mode-validation-pass2-2026-09-27.log.
Fresh residual Playwright E2E: 1 passed / 1 skipped; results/plan45/phase6/phase6-b14-residual-e2e-validation-2026-09-27.log.
Next.js production build and its TypeScript stage succeeded in both aggregate Browser Mode and fresh E2E runs.
The existing batch3-b production-route case was compared against the removed normal-route advanced-series predicates.
knownConstraints: Tooltip #231's current post-wheel outcome assertions are absent from source and their deletion provenance remains unknown; this checkpoint does not restore or attribute them.
The previously absent focus-management test bodies and desktop tooltip hover test deletion retain unknown provenance and are outside B14.

The six original accessibility source cases were disabled with describe.skip and had no skip-reason comments; two weak checks were retired without claiming coverage of range-picker operation or a WCAG criterion beyond the concrete B14 contrast assertion.
JEV review supplements browser tests, build/typecheck, and lint.
state.outputRequirement: Choose one listed choice. For a reason choice, give a case-specific finding, affected location or requirement, observed evidence, and either a concrete proposed fix or exact additional evidence needed. Do not invent details.

implementation.instructions: Does the supplied implementation and verification evidence satisfy the approved residual E2E audit plan? Return a probability distribution over the listed choices.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The implementation and evidence support the plan while preserving stated boundaries.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: A disposition or assertion conflicts with the plan; identify the case and correction.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: A specific additional requirement or decision is needed to judge the implementation.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: A specific implementation detail or validation evidence is missing.
criteria.implementation_issue: An implementation or test defect exists; identify its location, evidence, and fix.
criteria.scope_violation: The implementation changed cases outside the approved scope; identify them and the required adjustment.
criteria.other: A material case-specific concern does not fit the listed reasons; identify its location and fix or needed evidence.
criteria.indeterminate: The evidence is insufficient to judge the implementation; identify exactly what is missing.
